description: Five prompts to probe remote notion/chat behavior around truncated JSON, Still generating loops, waitOnly polling, and HELPERS_VERSION 25+ incomplete-JSON guards.

prompts.purpose: Baseline: tiny JSON-only reply should finish in seconds with valid parsed JSON.
passCriteria: Initial submit or waitOnly poll returns answer (not Still generating) within 1 poll
probe.looksFinal is true when answer is returned

prompts.purpose: Medium JSON schema: truncated streaming JSON must yield Still generating, never partial success with invalid JSON.
passCriteria: If DOM answer is incomplete JSON, chat returns error Still generating (not answer with truncated text)
When complete, answerJson.planets is a non-empty array
probe.looksFinal false while JSON is truncated
No identical-answer-stuck: same hash across polls while Still generating

prompts.purpose: News-style unique_topics JSON (search + long output): main repro candidate for identical incomplete reply loops.
passCriteria: Eventually completes with parseable JSON containing unique_topics array OR
While incomplete, each poll returns Still generating (not frozen partial answer)
If stuck: flag identicalAnswerHashAcrossPolls with looksFinal false
helpersVersion >= 25 should treat incomplete JSON as in-flight

prompts.purpose: Non-JSON exact token reply: prose path must still complete without JSON guards interfering.
passCriteria: No Still generating loop after toolbar shows complete

prompts.purpose: JSON with preamble risk: model may add prose before JSON; tests parseAnswerJson and looksLikeFinalAnswer recovery.
passCriteria: When complete, parseAnswerJson extracts {probe:preamble, ok:true} despite optional leading sentence
Incomplete preamble+partial JSON returns Still generating, not partial success
jsonRecovered true is acceptable when raw differs from compact JSON
